conventions.comparison: Monthly minus fixed on identical date/time/stock keys; one seed and one research year. Age and calendar conditions are confounded; no causal claim or automatic promotion.
conventions.constant_scores: RankIC, IC and portfolios undefined; missing values are not replaced by zero.
conventions.failure_flags: rank_ic < 0 and long_short_return < 0 are descriptive failure flags, not significance or promotion tests. Undefined values are separate.
conventions.granularity: Every declared trading date and all eight sample times, separately for each policy.
conventions.missing_labels: Target coverage is measured against the independent stock universe at every timestamp; missing targets remain counted, never fabricated. Score distributions and portfolios use the identical available-target stock keys for both policies.
conventions.scope: Local approximate gross forward-label returns; no fees, execution, compounding or official score.
conventions.short_return: Return of the bottom-score basket before negation; short_position_return = -short_return; long_short_return = long_return + short_position_return.
conventions.summaries: Monthly and month/time distributions only. No annual or pooled average, IR, Sharpe or aggregate score is exported.
conventions.turnover: Half L1 change in net long-short weights, consecutive sample times including overnight and month boundaries; first timestamp undefined.
conventions.weight_age: Calendar days and independent-universe trading dates strictly after last training date, through prediction date inclusive.
